integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled exact verifier checks the half-plane intersections and shoelace identity in Q(sqrt(2),sqrt(3)). The later full curve-area computation is used only for comparison. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns the canonical corner-intersection polygon M, not the full Erdős–Mordell region E or the curve-bounded component E'. It gives a rigorous equilateral lower-area certificate but does not settle the universal area-gap conjecture. Unindexed or differently phrased prior calculations remain possible.
title: Exact area of the canonical Erdős–Mordell extension hexagon for an equilateral triangle
